name: How can I prevent future ceiling leaks from rain?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future ceiling leaks from rain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future ceiling leaks involves regular roof maintenance. This includes inspecting your roof annually for damaged or missing shingles, checking flashing around vents and chimneys, and ensuring gutters and downspouts are clear of debris. Trim overhanging tree branches to prevent damage and keep leaves out of gutters. Addressing minor roof issues promptly can prevent them from escalating into major leaks during heavy rain. Consider professional roof inspections every few years.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future ceiling leaks by regularly inspecting your roof for damage, cleaning gutters, trimming tree branches, and addressing minor roof issues promptly.
